SELECT BOOKSET_ID id,BOOKSET_NAME text FROM BOK_BOOKSET where 1=1
AND BOOKSET_TYPE != #{booksetType}
AND (BOOKSET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR BOOKSET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT FINPROD_ID id,FINPROD_ABBR text FROM FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1
AND FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND (FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by FINPROD_TYPE,FINPROD_ID
